user_saw: On iPhone Safari, tapping the chat composer while a nearby reply streamed contact-related words could bring up AutoFill Contact with the user's own contact details.
summary: The fix associates a visually hidden HTML label with the composer textarea so Safari uses the label instead of nearby message text to infer the field type.
reasoning: The Solid port preserved a textarea without an associated HTML label, and the legacy composer already lacked one at the July 1 history boundary. The older history was unavailable offline, and the PR demonstrates the failure on iOS 27 without establishing whether earlier Safari versions or composer layouts showed the same behavior.
